description: Validation at the structural level (section 8). validate always answers status ok with levels; an invalid dataset shows the level failed with the refusal code. An open-stage refusal makes structural failed with its refusal code; an unsupported feature makes structural incomplete with its unsupported code and a non-empty reason. Dependent levels are incomplete.

families.validate-structural/valid-dataset: every valid dataset completes this level and its prerequisites
families.validate-structural/fault-at-lowest-leve: each fault at the lowest validation level that detects it (validation_level in generators/faults.json)
